description: This file defines the PaymentModule interface which declares methods for payment processing operations such as initialization, authorization, capture, and refund within the e-commerce system.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the payment module configuration using provided integration configuration and merchant store, throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction, such as a PayPal checkout, returning a Transaction object.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs payment authorization for a list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a payment for a specific order and transaction.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in a single step for a list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund, either partial or full, for a given transaction.
